tag_definitions.push: The player moves objects by walking into them (including chains of pushed objects).
tag_definitions.pull: The player drags, lifts or carries objects instead of only pushing them.
tag_definitions.slide: The player or objects keep moving until blocked (ice, sliding moves).
tag_definitions.gravity: Unsupported objects or the player fall each turn; side-view or platform play.
tag_definitions.teleport: Portals or teleporters move things between distant cells.
tag_definitions.merge: Two objects combine into a different object (fusing, adding up values).
tag_definitions.spawn: Moves create new objects or copies (duplication, emitters, splitting).
tag_definitions.transform: Objects change type or state when pushed, touched or triggered.
tag_definitions.multi-avatar: More than one controllable character, moved together or by switching control.
tag_definitions.remote-movement: Player input moves other objects at a distance (shared moves, arrows, magnets, mirrored movers).
tag_definitions.switch-door: Pressure plates, switches or levers open, close or toggle gates and walls.
tag_definitions.key-lock: Collected keys or tokens unlock doors or barriers.
tag_definitions.collect: Items are picked up by walking onto them (coins, pickups, food).
tag_definitions.fill-pit: Objects pushed into holes, pits or water fill them and make them walkable.
tag_definitions.trail: Movement leaves a persistent trail, path or body behind (snake, path drawing).
tag_definitions.rotation: Objects rotate, or facing direction changes what a move or action does (not cosmetic left/right sprites).
tag_definitions.spread: Something propagates cell by cell (fire, shadow, virus, liquid, beams of state).
tag_definitions.destruction: Objects are removed or destroyed (explosions, cutters, crushing, pits that consume).
tag_definitions.hazard: Cells or objects that kill the player or force a restart.
tag_definitions.npc: Autonomous enemies or creatures that move by their own rules each turn.
tag_definitions.beam: Line-of-sight effects: lasers, light, shots or rays that travel across the board.
tag_definitions.match-clear: Groups of matching objects are cleared when aligned or adjacent.
tag_definitions.crate-on-target: Win by covering every target with a crate-like object (Sokoban goal).
tag_definitions.reach-exit: Win by moving the player (or players) onto an exit or goal cell.
tag_definitions.hidden-state: Rule-relevant state is not visible in the rendered frame (aliased sprites, counters, phases).
tag_definitions.irreversible: Moves can create dead ends; progress often needs undo or restart.
tag_definitions.multi-goal: Several win conditions must hold together, or objects must be sorted to different goals.
tag_definitions.text-instructions: In-game message screens explain or hint at the mechanics.
tag_definitions.counting: Solutions depend on counting, numbers or arithmetic.
tag_definitions.limited-resources: A finite move budget, stamina, ammunition or consumable objects constrains play.
tag_definitions.cascades: One input triggers multi-step chain reactions resolved before the next input.
tag_definitions.randomness: Random rules make transitions non-deterministic (derived from the source audit).
tag_definitions.realtime: The game advances on a timer without input (derived from the source audit).
tag_definitions.action-button: The action key (ACTION5) has a game-specific effect (derived from the source audit).
tag_definitions.many-levels: At least 12 playable levels (derived from the level count).
tag_definitions.large-maps: The largest map has at least 300 cells (derived from the source audit).

ps_1_2_3_ban-v1.title: 1-2-3-Ban
ps_1_2_3_ban-v1.author: Alan Hazelden
ps_1_2_3_ban-v1.summary: Push numbered balls in sequence so the active chain 1,2,3... absorbs and activates the next higher number; win when no inactive numbers remain.

ps_2d_whale_world-v1.title: 2D Whale World
ps_2d_whale_world-v1.author: increpare
ps_2d_whale_world-v1.summary: Movement creates directional beams whose perpendicular interaction removes whales.

ps_9x9_go-v1.title: 9x9 Go
ps_9x9_go-v1.author: Dennis Au
ps_9x9_go-v1.summary: Two-player Go on a 9x9 board: players alternate placing black and white stones, capturing surrounded groups, with suicide and ko rules; no win condition.

ps_a_sneeze_a_day-v1.title: A Sneeze A Day Keeps The Crates Away
ps_a_sneeze_a_day-v1.author: Alan Hazelden
ps_a_sneeze_a_day-v1.summary: Sweep dust with a toggleable broom; stepping on dust makes the player sneeze, blowing wind that shoves crates onto targets, and dust under a crate is a dead end.

ps_aaaah_i_m_being_attacked-v1.title: Aaaah! I'm Being Attacked by a Giant Tentacle!
ps_aaaah_i_m_being_attacked-v1.author: Ricky Liu
ps_aaaah_i_m_being_attacked-v1.summary: A giant tentacle snakes forward in real time, pushing or dragging the player's path; you must steer it so the player is rescued by burning the tentacle at the fire.

ps_alien_disco-v1.title: Alien Disco
ps_alien_disco-v1.author: Toph Wells
ps_alien_disco-v1.summary: Move all dancers at once; walking into warp edges wraps them to the opposite warp, and every dancer must end on a target cell.

ps_alternatey-v1.title: Alternatey
ps_alternatey-v1.author: Stephen Lavelle
ps_alternatey-v1.summary: Several white squares move together, each mirroring the previous move with alternating copies, and all must land on goals simultaneously.

ps_always_magnets-v1.title: Always with the magnets
ps_always_magnets-v1.author: Marcos Donnantuoni
ps_always_magnets-v1.summary: Activate a magnet to pull or push crates by polarity, eat pellets to flip polarity, and reach the target cell.

ps_atlas_shrank-v1.title: Atlas Shrank
ps_atlas_shrank-v1.author: James Noeckel
ps_atlas_shrank-v1.summary: Gravity, jumping, carrying and dropping crates, switches, doors, and orientation interact.

ps_baba_is_you-v1.title: BABA IS YOU demake
ps_baba_is_you-v1.author: @pyjamads
ps_baba_is_you-v1.summary: Baba Is You demake: push word blocks to form rules like X IS YOU/WIN/PUSH/STOP/SINK/DEFEAT or X IS Y, then touch a win object to finish.

ps_bal_ru_s_curse-v1.title: Bal Ru's Curse cruelty-free demake
ps_bal_ru_s_curse-v1.author: Creative Windows [cloned by CHz]
ps_bal_ru_s_curse-v1.summary: Move a cursor over a randomized 4x4 grid of tall and long blocks, swapping adjacent blocks along their allowed axis, until each row holds only one block type.

ps_barrier_trail-v1.title: Barrier Trail
ps_barrier_trail-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_barrier_trail-v1.summary: Touch a target to activate the level, then push crates that slide in their pushed direction until blocked so they cover all targets.

ps_beam_islands-v1.title: Beam Islands
ps_beam_islands-v1.author: mjau
ps_beam_islands-v1.summary: Move rigid islands carrying the player, bridge across gaps and merge adjacent islands with action so islands cover every beam.

ps_becoming_one-v1.title: Becoming one
ps_becoming_one-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_becoming_one-v1.summary: Push chains of cubes so all cubes form one orthogonally connected group; any cube left disconnected from the player's group dies and the level fails.

ps_block_touching-v1.title: Block touching
ps_block_touching-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_block_touching-v1.summary: Push numbered crates; touching a change tile turns the player into a form that, on touching crates, counts them down and removes them, clearing all blocks.

ps_blocker_snake-v1.title: Blocker snake
ps_blocker_snake-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_blocker_snake-v1.summary: Snake-like player leaves a following body trail that blocks movement and collects orbs by walking into them, growing the tail; goal is to collect every orb.

ps_bomb_n_grouping-v1.title: Bomb n grouping
ps_bomb_n_grouping-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_bomb_n_grouping-v1.summary: Push cubes that slide until blocked; a pink bomb cube hitting another cube explodes, and adjacent same-color cubes are cleared. Goal: remove all cubes.

ps_bomb_n_ice-v1.title: bomb n ice
ps_bomb_n_ice-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_bomb_n_ice-v1.summary: Push ice crates that slide until blocked, and bomb crates that explode into smoke on hitting walls, to cover every target with ice.

ps_botsket_ball-v1.title: Botsket Ball
ps_botsket_ball-v1.summary: Player draws bots and box bridges with action and direction inputs, then starts a simulation so bots push the ball onto the net without falling into holes.

ps_boxes_and_balloons-v1.title: Boxes & Balloons
ps_boxes_and_balloons-v1.author: Ben Reilly
ps_boxes_and_balloons-v1.summary: Side-view gravity puzzle where the player pushes crates and buoyant balloons and climbs ladders, avoiding spikes, to reach the exit.

ps_bruised-v1.title: Bruised
ps_bruised-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_bruised-v1.summary: Sokoban variant where pushing crates against bruise/blocker markers can stop them; push crates onto all targets.

ps_castlemouse-v1.title: Memories Of Castlemouse
ps_castlemouse-v1.author: Wayne Myers
ps_castlemouse-v1.summary: Select animals to scare others in a chain (elephant>dog>cat>mouse), sliding them until blocked, to drive every mouse into a hole.

ps_chasm-v1.title: Chasm
ps_chasm-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_chasm-v1.summary: Push crates into chasm pits to fill them and build a walkable path across the chasm so the player can reach the target at the top.

ps_closure_demake-v1.title: Closure Demake
ps_closure_demake-v1.author: Tyler Glaiel
ps_closure_demake-v1.summary: Side-view platformer where the player carries a light-emitting orb, which makes unseen walls solid and ladders usable, to reach the exit door, using keys and crates.

ps_coin_counter-v1.title: Coin Counter
ps_coin_counter-v1.summary: Collectibles update decimal digits, propagate carries, drive a display, and gate completion.

ps_collapsable_sokoban-v1.title: Collapsable Sokoban
ps_collapsable_sokoban-v1.author: Franklin P. Dyer
ps_collapsable_sokoban-v1.summary: Sokoban where walls in line with the player slide toward them each turn, closing in on space; push crates onto all targets.

ps_collapse-v1.title: Collapse
ps_collapse-v1.author: Terry Cavanagh
ps_collapse-v1.summary: Side-view jetpack platformer: push gravity-affected walls and mines, avoid mines, collect all flowers (opening doors via keys/flowers), then reach the exit.

ps_collapsing_tiles-v1.title: Collapsing tiles
ps_collapsing_tiles-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_collapsing_tiles-v1.summary: Traversed floor states propagate and collapse into pits.

ps_colour_chained-v1.title: Colour Chained
ps_colour_chained-v1.author: Dennis Au
ps_colour_chained-v1.summary: Rotate and drop pairs of coloured pieces with two linked cursors so three or more matching colours clear, with gravity cascades, until the board is empty.

ps_compressed-v1.title: Compressed
ps_compressed-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_compressed-v1.summary: Pushing and spatial compression transform player or crate configurations.

ps_consumed_to_1-v1.title: consumed to 1
ps_consumed_to_1-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_consumed_to_1-v1.summary: Push crates into empty crates to merge and consume them, with empties gaining fill stages, until no empty crates remain and one crate is left.

ps_copy_pellets-v1.title: Copy pellets
ps_copy_pellets-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_copy_pellets-v1.summary: Push crates onto matching targets and eat all pellets; eating a pellet clones crates into empty cells, and pushing crates of different colors together destroys them.

ps_count_mover-v1.title: Count Mover
ps_count_mover-v1.author: Jonah Ostroff
ps_count_mover-v1.summary: Sokoban-style crate pushing onto goals while a displayed move counter is tracked, and the game judges whether the solution used few enough moves.

ps_covering_holes-v1.title: Covering holes
ps_covering_holes-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_covering_holes-v1.summary: Push crates into pits to fill them and make a path, avoiding falling into open pits, then walk the player onto the target exit.

ps_crate_cables-v1.title: Crate Cables
ps_crate_cables-v1.author: Jack Kutilek
ps_crate_cables-v1.summary: Push crates onto targets to form chains of active crates that wire-connect signalling targets to open gates, avoiding anti-targets, then reach the exit.

ps_cratopia-v1.title: Cratopia
ps_cratopia-v1.author: CHz [v1]
ps_cratopia-v1.summary: Side-view platformer where you push or climb crates, rain new crates in edit mode, burn them on fire, and cross crumbling floors to reach the goal.

ps_cubes_barrier-v1.title: Cubes barrier
ps_cubes_barrier-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_cubes_barrier-v1.summary: Sokoban where pushed crates keep sliding in their pushed direction (and chain-push other crates) until blocked; cover all targets with crates.

ps_cubes_medusa-v1.title: cubes medusa
ps_cubes_medusa-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_cubes_medusa-v1.summary: Pushing crates stacks them into higher levels (crate to crate5) and crates pushed into each other vanish; put a cube on every target.

ps_cyber_lasso-v1.title: Cyber-Lasso
ps_cyber_lasso-v1.author: Alan Hazelden
ps_cyber_lasso-v1.summary: Throw a lasso to drag crates or pull yourself along a rope, powering buttons and electric floors to open doors, bridge holes and reach the reactor or exit.

ps_dang_i_m_huge-v1.title: Dang I'm Huge
ps_dang_i_m_huge-v1.author: Guilherme Tows
ps_dang_i_m_huge-v1.summary: The player and blocks grow into 2x2 huge forms on zap pads (and shrink back), pushing huge blocks as a unit, to cover all targets with blocks.

ps_dark_pellets-v1.title: Dark Pellets
ps_dark_pellets-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_dark_pellets-v1.summary: Push purple pellets into colored blocks to turn them into ice, trail or pit floors, then clear the dark pellets with the white block to win.

ps_dharma_dojo_demake-v1.title: Dharma Dojo demake
ps_dharma_dojo_demake-v1.author: Metro [cloned by CHz]
ps_dharma_dojo_demake-v1.summary: Move up and down and hammer rows of colored blocks into a hopper; a full same-color hopper clears, a mixed one pushes up, and you win by clearing all blocks.

ps_directional-v1.title: Directional
ps_directional-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_directional-v1.summary: Pushing a crate sends it sliding one step in its own fixed direction, and the player must get crates onto every target.

ps_duality-v1.title: duality
ps_duality-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_duality-v1.summary: Push ice-blue and fire-orange crates, which slide until blocked, so each lands on its matching colored target square.

ps_dungeon_janitor-v1.title: Dungeon Janitor
ps_dungeon_janitor-v1.author: Farbs
ps_dungeon_janitor-v1.summary: Slime grows from random heads each turn; the player stomps slime as they walk and must clear all of it so the exit opens, then reach the exit.

ps_dup_block-v1.title: dup-block
ps_dup_block-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_dup_block-v1.summary: Pushing a crate duplicates it into the free cell beyond; the player must fill every target with crates while walls and the grid constrain the copies.

ps_easy_enigma-v1.title: Easy Enigma
ps_easy_enigma-v1.summary: Sokoban where only one crate can be pushed at a time, wrapped in meta levels with glitchy text and letter tiles the player pushes and rearranges to start or edit the game.

ps_ebony_and_ivory-v1.title: Ebony & Ivory
ps_ebony_and_ivory-v1.author: Guilherme Töws
ps_ebony_and_ivory-v1.summary: Two avatars move together over black and white floor tiles, shifting and swapping tiles as they go, and the goal is to bring them adjacent so only gold remains.

ps_electric_wire-v1.title: Electric wire
ps_electric_wire-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_electric_wire-v1.summary: Push green crates onto targets, with the player's wire trail and special crates sending electric pulses that shove other crates at a distance.

ps_enclosed-v1.title: Enclosed
ps_enclosed-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_enclosed-v1.summary: Walking over cells twice builds walls, a spawner emits pushable cubes that can destroy walls and other cubes, and the aim is a high on-screen score.

ps_enqueue-v1.title: Enqueue
ps_enqueue-v1.author: Allen Webster
ps_enqueue-v1.summary: The action button manipulates an abstract queue through send and receive modes and colored pads.

ps_esl_puzzle_game-v1.title: ESL Puzzle Game -- アダムのパズルゲーム
ps_esl_puzzle_game-v1.author: A.R.Nakama
ps_esl_puzzle_game-v1.summary: Push colored crates onto matching targets (gray ones only by pulling-direction moves), with triples vanishing and walls forming on wall targets.

ps_esl_puzzle_game_challenge_mode-v1.title: ESL Puzzle Game -- CHALLENGE MODE アダムのパズルゲーム
ps_esl_puzzle_game_challenge_mode-v1.author: A.R.Nakama
ps_esl_puzzle_game_challenge_mode-v1.summary: Push red and blue crates (pull gray ones) onto matching targets; three in a row vanish, and crates on wall-targets become walls, closing doors.

ps_explod-v1.title: Explod
ps_explod-v1.author: CHz
ps_explod-v1.summary: Bombs have fuse states, chain reactions, water interactions, and lethal explosions.

ps_extra_lives-v1.title: Extra lives
ps_extra_lives-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_extra_lives-v1.summary: Sokoban where crates must cover all targets; walking into a pit kills the player but respawns them, and pushing crates fills pits, with a limited number of lives.

ps_extra_push-v1.title: extra push
ps_extra_push-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_extra_push-v1.summary: Sokoban variant where pushing a crate chain also pushes crates beyond it, and yellow crates must end up covering every target.

ps_extra_step-v1.title: Extra step
ps_extra_step-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_extra_step-v1.summary: Powerups change step length and object behavior while pits, timers, and multi-cell objects interact.

ps_fatigued_square_maze-v1.title: Fatigued Square Maze
ps_fatigued_square_maze-v1.author: Ove Ahlman
ps_fatigued_square_maze-v1.summary: Changing movement direction consumes stamina and pickups restore it.

ps_feeling_like_filling-v1.title: Feeling like Filling
ps_feeling_like_filling-v1.author: Marcos Donnantuoni
ps_feeling_like_filling-v1.summary: The player can push and pull crates and must fill targets exactly.

ps_fire_in_winter-v1.title: fire in winter
ps_fire_in_winter-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_fire_in_winter-v1.summary: Push crates into the furnace to burn them, using portals that teleport the player and crates; win when no crates remain.

ps_fish_friend-v1.title: Fish Friend
ps_fish_friend-v1.summary: Side-view platformer where a human who can jump and push rocks and lights, and a fish swap control, trying to reach the right-hand exit without drowning in water.

ps_flower_dance-v1.title: Flower Dance
ps_flower_dance-v1.author: quat
ps_flower_dance-v1.summary: The player runs through a garden leaving flower buds behind that grow into blocking plants; stepping on a bud is fatal-ish, and the goal is reaching the End cell.

ps_flying_kick-v1.title: Flying Kick
ps_flying_kick-v1.author: Aaron Steed
ps_flying_kick-v1.summary: A side-view platformer where the player jumps and flying-kicks crates horizontally to bridge gaps, break walls, press switches and open gates, avoiding spikes, to reach the exit.

ps_freeform_bal_ru_s_curse-v1.title: Freeform Bal Ru's Curse
ps_freeform_bal_ru_s_curse-v1.author: Creative Windows [cloned by CHz]
ps_freeform_bal_ru_s_curse-v1.summary: Move a cursor over a randomized 4x4 grid and swap blocks (tall ones vertically, wide ones horizontally) until every row or column holds one block type.

ps_fuse_to_green-v1.title: fuse to green
ps_fuse_to_green-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_fuse_to_green-v1.summary: Push blue and yellow crates that slide when shoved; colliding them fuses them into a green crate, and green crates must cover all targets.

ps_fused_copy-v1.title: Fused copy
ps_fused_copy-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_fused_copy-v1.summary: Push pink and blue crates into each other so they fuse and vanish, with pushed crates cloning into neighbors; clear every crate to win.

ps_fused_pieces-v1.title: Fused pieces
ps_fused_pieces-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_fused_pieces-v1.summary: Push crates of two colors into each other so touching different-colored crates fuse into walls, aiming to remove every crate from the level.

ps_garten_der_medusen-v1.title: Garten der Medusen
ps_garten_der_medusen-v1.author: Stephen Lavelle
ps_garten_der_medusen-v1.summary: Medusas fire gaze beams that turn the player into a statue (leaving a spawner to create a new player); walk into every Medusa to kill them without being seen.

ps_grouping-v1.title: Grouping
ps_grouping-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_grouping-v1.summary: Push crates of two colors so same-colored blocks form adjacent groups, which then vanish; clear all crates and walls (a Sokoban-like grouping puzzle).

ps_guiding_blocks-v1.title: guiding blocks
ps_guiding_blocks-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_guiding_blocks-v1.summary: Push crates to guide autonomous spawned people, who walk forward and die on walls or blocked crates, so that a person reaches the target.

ps_hack_the_net-v1.title: Hack the Net
ps_hack_the_net-v1.author: Alan Hazelden
ps_hack_the_net-v1.summary: Move a player along network lines between nodes, consuming edges as a trail, to reach all targets while avoiding self-crossing, anti-virus pursuit, and firewalls opened by keys.

ps_hue_change-v1.title: Hue change
ps_hue_change-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_hue_change-v1.summary: Push crates so a new crate spawns between two same-colour crates and both change colour, while touching black dots to maximize an on-screen score.

ps_i_herd_u_liek_water_templs-v1.title: i herd u liek water templs
ps_i_herd_u_liek_water_templs-v1.author: Denis Prause
ps_i_herd_u_liek_water_templs-v1.summary: Push crates horizontally while using up/down keys to control a wave machine whose water level lifts floating crates and the player onto targets.

ps_ice_cream_stick-v1.title: 🍡 -ooo- 🍡
ps_ice_cream_stick-v1.author: Baku
ps_ice_cream_stick-v1.summary: Move a skewer of sticks to push and stack dango onto it in the order 1-2-3 (A, B, C) to clear all floating dango; wrong orders can't be skewered.

ps_ice_path-v1.title: Ice path
ps_ice_path-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_ice_path-v1.summary: Push crates and touch targets to convert your trail into ice blocks that slide, then get ice blocks onto every target.

ps_icecrates-v1.title: IceCrates
ps_icecrates-v1.author: Tyler Glaiel
ps_icecrates-v1.summary: Directional movement produces long sliding and pushing chains with water interactions.

ps_inbetween-v1.title: inbetween
ps_inbetween-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_inbetween-v1.summary: Sokoban-style game where the player pushes crates onto every target; the win condition counts crates and walls as covering targets.

ps_infected-v1.title: infected
ps_infected-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_infected-v1.summary: Sokoban where the player pushes crates onto targets, but a crate pushed by the player becomes an infected crate2 that can no longer count, so each crate must be moved carefully.

ps_interconnection-v1.title: interconnection
ps_interconnection-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_interconnection-v1.summary: Sokoban variant where pushing one crate also shifts adjacent crates in the same direction (unless blocked); cover every target button with crates.

ps_it_dies_in_the_light-v1.title: It Dies In The Light
ps_it_dies_in_the_light-v1.author: Christopher Wells
ps_it_dies_in_the_light-v1.summary: Light beams, prisms, shadows, and opaque objects determine safe and winning states.

ps_jam3_game-v1.title: JAM3 Game
ps_jam3_game-v1.author: chaotic_iak
ps_jam3_game-v1.summary: Match-3 game where the player swaps places with gems under gravity; three matching gems pop and refill, and the goal is to get the player or gems onto targets.

ps_kettle-v1.title: Kettle
ps_kettle-v1.author: stephen lavelle
ps_kettle-v1.summary: Many police avatars each respond to only some input directions and push crates together; cover every target with a crate.

ps_knightoban-v1.title: Knightoban
ps_knightoban-v1.author: Nick Sperry
ps_knightoban-v1.summary: Crates can be selected and moved using knight-like displacement patterns.

ps_life_is_hard-v1.title: Life is Hard
ps_life_is_hard-v1.author: Marcos Donnantuoni
ps_life_is_hard-v1.summary: A Game-of-Life-like puzzle: toggle cells at the player's position, birth and death follow neighbor-count rules, and the goal is to eliminate all cells.

ps_lights_down-v1.title: Lights down
ps_lights_down-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_lights_down-v1.summary: Push crates onto targets; green and pink crates emit light trails in their push direction that mark cells as targets, and all crates must cover targets.

ps_lil_purple-v1.title: The Lil' Purple Marble
ps_lil_purple-v1.author: Hoboken Pudding
ps_lil_purple-v1.summary: A marble rolls until blocked, pushing sliding ice crates and crates, filling holes to bridge them, and must reach the golden ring target.

ps_lime_rick-v1.title: Lime Rick
ps_lime_rick-v1.author: Tommi Tuovinen
ps_lime_rick-v1.summary: A growing worm-like player extends a body trail (vertical growth is capped by head stage), pushes crates, eats apples to shrink, and must reach the exit.

ps_linked-v1.title: Linked
ps_linked-v1.summary: Push top-layer and bottom-layer prototypes that drag each other when stacked, with golems mirroring the player's moves, to cover both goal types.

ps_liquid_war_alpha-v1.title: Liquid War Alpha
ps_liquid_war_alpha-v1.author: Ryan Hitchman
ps_liquid_war_alpha-v1.summary: Realtime Liquid War simulation where red and blue slime swarms flow toward their leaders via pathfinding and convert each other on contact; no win condition is defined.

ps_love_and_pieces-v1.title: Love and Pieces
ps_love_and_pieces-v1.author: lexaloffle
ps_love_and_pieces-v1.summary: Move all player pieces together so they touch gray blocks, converting them into players in chain reactions, until no gray blocks remain.

ps_maera_public_works-v1.title: Maera Public Works
ps_maera_public_works-v1.author: CHz
ps_maera_public_works-v1.summary: Push crates and blocks in ditches, climb ladders, and toggle switches that route flowing water through gates to power a wheel and open the exit; don't drown.

ps_magik-v1.title: Magik
ps_magik-v1.summary: Pick up fire, ice or wind spells at magic circles and cast them in the facing direction to freeze water, burn shrubs or blow away ashes, then reach the target.

ps_magnetic-v1.title: Magnetic
ps_magnetic-v1.author: nick cavazos
ps_magnetic-v1.summary: Movement pulls aligned magnetic objects, with conflicts suppressing motion.

ps_magnetized-v1.title: Magnetized
ps_magnetized-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_magnetized-v1.summary: Pushed cubes drag adjacent cubes along via magnet-like grabbing and chain movement, and the player must get a cube onto every target.

ps_manic_ammo-v1.title: Manic Ammo
ps_manic_ammo-v1.author: David Eastman
ps_manic_ammo-v1.summary: Push shells and mines and use Action to open crates into shells or fire guns, so chain explosions clear the way, then reach the exit without being blown up.

ps_marble_shoot-v1.title: Marble Shoot
ps_marble_shoot-v1.author: Stuart Burfield
ps_marble_shoot-v1.summary: Push sliding marbles that bounce off walls and redirecting arrows, so every red marble falls into a hole; a green marble falling in restarts the level.

ps_matchpub-v1.title: Match Pub
ps_matchpub-v1.author: bregehr
ps_matchpub-v1.summary: Slide the player along a row to shift bar items; items drop under gravity, and aligned triples of three matching items pop, clearing all target cells and rubies.

ps_mazezam-v1.title: MazezaM
ps_mazezam-v1.author: Malcolm Tyrrell
ps_mazezam-v1.summary: Push whole rows of crates (all crates in a row move together, only if the row end is free) to clear a path, then reach the exit; a gate closes behind the player.

ps_mc_escher_s_equestrian_armageddon-v1.title: MC Escher's Equestrian Armageddon
ps_mc_escher_s_equestrian_armageddon-v1.author: Anna Clarke
ps_mc_escher_s_equestrian_armageddon-v1.summary: Escher-style gravity changes as the player walks onto stairs and rotates to a new orientation; use Action next to horses to kill them all, which wins.

ps_microban-v1.title: Microban
ps_microban-v1.author: David Skinner
ps_microban-v1.summary: Classic Sokoban: push crates into corridors and rooms so every target is covered by a crate across ten Microban levels.

ps_midas-v1.title: Midas
ps_midas-v1.author: wanderlands
ps_midas-v1.summary: Jump phases, gravity, crown transfer, material transformation, water, and a derived win state interact.

ps_mirror_isles-v1.title: Mirror Isles
ps_mirror_isles-v1.author: Alan Hazelden
ps_mirror_isles-v1.summary: Push crates into water to make land, and swap places with your line-of-sight reflection bounced by mirrors, to reach the target.

ps_mirror_mines-v1.title: Mirror Mines
ps_mirror_mines-v1.author: Marcos Donnantuoni
ps_mirror_mines-v1.summary: The player mines mirror blocks to steer a diagonal laser-like ray onto every target, which opens the door that the player then walks to.

ps_modality-v1.title: Modality
ps_modality-v1.author: Sean Barrett
ps_modality-v1.summary: Movement and pushing are constrained by matching black and white modes.

ps_monster_mess-v1.title: monster mess
ps_monster_mess-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_monster_mess-v1.summary: Push crates to block rotating monsters that leave mess trails; crates or the player clear mess, and the level is won when no mess remains.

ps_movement_garden-v1.title: Movement Garden
ps_movement_garden-v1.author: Jack Kutilek
ps_movement_garden-v1.summary: Direction tokens held by player, crates and shrines allow movement in that direction and are passed on when pushing; shrines toggle colored walls; cover targets.

ps_moving_target-v1.title: Moving target
ps_moving_target-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_moving_target-v1.summary: The target responds to player movement and must be manipulated relative to a crate.

ps_mowing-v1.title: Mowing
ps_mowing-v1.summary: The action button uses an oriented tool to clear tiles while rocks remain pushable.

ps_multi_word_dictionary_game-v1.title: Multi-word Dictionary Game
ps_multi_word_dictionary_game-v1.author: Sarah Northway
ps_multi_word_dictionary_game-v1.summary: Push letter tiles A, C and T into adjacent order spelling CAT or ACT in a row, which creates a Won marker and completes the level.

ps_n_little_indians-v1.title: N little indians
ps_n_little_indians-v1.summary: Player indian pushes other indians while crocodiles chase and kill them; acting on the spawner leaves an indian behind and spawns a new player. No win condition is defined.

ps_okosban-v1.title: Okosban
ps_okosban-v1.author: Ove Ahlman
ps_okosban-v1.summary: Reverse Sokoban: when the player steps away from an adjacent crate, the crate is shoved the opposite way; cover all targets with crates.

ps_on_and_off-v1.title: On and off
ps_on_and_off-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_on_and_off-v1.summary: Object interactions temporarily disable and restore corresponding wall types.

ps_oskars_maze-v1.title: Oskar's Maze
ps_oskars_maze-v1.author: Whuk Games
ps_oskars_maze-v1.summary: Navigate three mazes on faces of a 3D cube with linked avatars whose allowed move directions depend on the active grid (toggled by action); all must reach targets.

ps_outward_force-v1.title: Outward force
ps_outward_force-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_outward_force-v1.summary: Player pushes crates, which then shoot outward in all directions pushing other objects, filling pits and being destroyed by the pusher, to reach the exit at the top.

ps_overstep-v1.title: Overstep
ps_overstep-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_overstep-v1.summary: The player pushes crates by leaping over them, landing on the far side, and must reach the target while walls and crates block the path.

ps_pants_shirt_cap-v1.title: Pants, Shirt, Cap
ps_pants_shirt_cap-v1.author: Jaewoong Hwang
ps_pants_shirt_cap-v1.summary: Push clothes and obstacles around, then dress in order (pants, shirt, cap) via Action and deliver yourself to the package guy; bookshelves and cats are hazards.

ps_paralands-v1.title: ParaLands
ps_paralands-v1.author: Lukas
ps_paralands-v1.summary: Player pushes crates and balls, fills pits, holds switches, avoids chasing enemies and trapdoors, and swaps between two parallel universes to reach the exit.

ps_path_lines-v1.title: Path lines
ps_path_lines-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_path_lines-v1.summary: Push crates onto all targets in a Sokoban-style puzzle, where crates project path lines in four directions that stop the player from moving into them.

ps_pathmaker-v1.title: Pathmaker
ps_pathmaker-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_pathmaker-v1.summary: Player pushes crates that, when pushed against the player's pulled-back side, crumble; walking onto the target2 square leaves a path of walls, and the player must reach target O.

ps_pit_trails-v1.title: Pit trails
ps_pit_trails-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_pit_trails-v1.summary: Push crates into pits, which tiles the player leaves behind turn into, to bridge the gaps and reach the exit target.

ps_ponies_jumping-v1.title: Ponies Jumping Synchronously
ps_ponies_jumping-v1.author: vytah
ps_ponies_jumping-v1.summary: Control several pony characters with distinct abilities (jump, push boulders, smash, teleport, zap) moved together, avoiding fire and falling rocks, to get one to the exit.

ps_portal_ban-v1.title: Portal-ban
ps_portal_ban-v1.author: Noah Krim
ps_portal_ban-v1.summary: The player shoots two oriented portals whose placement and traversal depend on surfaces and occlusion.

ps_positional-v1.title: Positional
ps_positional-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_positional-v1.summary: Push crates around a checkered board so that each crate sits on a specific tile color without lining up with same-type crates or violating per-type position rules.

ps_pretender_to_the_crown-v1.title: pretender to the crown
ps_pretender_to_the_crown-v1.author: colin thil
ps_pretender_to_the_crown-v1.summary: Walk into enemies next to prisoners to turn prisoners into soldiers that follow the player's trail; push crates and bring the player to the exit.

ps_pull_and_push-v1.title: pull and push
ps_pull_and_push-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_pull_and_push-v1.summary: Push crates and drag-push crate2 blocks; a crate pushed into a crate2 merges into a combined block, and combined blocks must cover every target.

ps_punt_mazes-v1.title: Punt mazes
ps_punt_mazes-v1.author: mathgrant et al.
ps_punt_mazes-v1.summary: The player and pucks slide until blocked by walls or other pucks; slide pucks onto every target, with moves that would land a puck on something disallowed.

ps_purple-v1.title: Purple
ps_purple-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_purple-v1.summary: Pushed crates change type and change back when blocked.

ps_push-v1.title: PUSH
ps_push-v1.author: lonebot - demake by rmmh
ps_push-v1.summary: The player gets one push of a rock or gun, filling pits and triggering buttons that fire arrow guns, to push or reach the idol and remove it.

ps_pushcat_jr-v1.title: Pushcat Jr
ps_pushcat_jr-v1.author: Zut!
ps_pushcat_jr-v1.summary: Dig through earth and push boulders and gems in a gravity cave, so three matching gems explode into coins, and collect all gems and coins without losing any.

ps_robot_repairs_1_2-v1.title: Robot Repairs 1.2
ps_robot_repairs_1_2-v1.author: Weeble
ps_robot_repairs_1_2-v1.summary: Robot pushes colored spheres that slide until blocked onto matching sockets, using blue teleporters, yellow hologram bridges and red lasers that kill or break walls.

ps_roll_those_sixes-v1.title: Roll those Sixes
ps_roll_those_sixes-v1.author: Marcos Donnantuoni
ps_roll_those_sixes-v1.summary: Push dice into each other so their pips add up (max six) and merge into one die; win when only sixes remain.

ps_rotaters_cause-v1.title: Rotaters cause
ps_rotaters_cause-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_rotaters_cause-v1.summary: Attached and oriented objects rotate, push at a distance, fall into pits, and can destroy the player or crates.

ps_rows_and_columns-v1.title: rows and columns
ps_rows_and_columns-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_rows_and_columns-v1.summary: Push crates into walls that fire sliding shifts along rows and columns; crates hit by opposing shifts are destroyed, and the goal is to leave no crates.

ps_scaling_walls-v1.title: Scaling walls
ps_scaling_walls-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_scaling_walls-v1.summary: Side-view Sokoban where the player pushes crates horizontally; crates fall under gravity and must end up on every target.

ps_season_finale-v1.title: Season Finale
ps_season_finale-v1.summary: Four seasonal avatars in sequence each have unique rules (flowers, light beams, bunnies/birds, ice) and must reach the exit door on each level.

ps_self_alteration-v1.title: Self Alteration
ps_self_alteration-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_self_alteration-v1.summary: Sokoban where pushing crates onto targets; crates of different colors that touch recolor the player and form walls, and the goal is covering all targets.

ps_separation-v1.title: Separation
ps_separation-v1.author: Marcos Donnantuoni
ps_separation-v1.summary: All dice move together with each input and push each other; the goal is to move them so no two same-colored dice are orthogonally adjacent.

ps_shifting-v1.title: shifting
ps_shifting-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_shifting-v1.summary: Push crates; a pushed crate swaps type with shadow crates of the other colour in a line, so each green and yellow target ends up covered by a matching crate.

ps_side_painting-v1.title: Side painting
ps_side_painting-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_side_painting-v1.summary: Sokoban where crates pushed beside colored side-walls gain sticky edges that bond crates and neighbors into rigid groups moved together; cover all targets with crates.

ps_singleton_traffic-v1.title: Singleton Traffic
ps_singleton_traffic-v1.author: Toph Wells
ps_singleton_traffic-v1.summary: Every tile is a controllable avatar that moves only along an axis free of adjacent neighbours on the other axis; you win when no tile can move.

ps_skippa-v1.title: skippa
ps_skippa-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_skippa-v1.summary: Push pink crates around; a crate pushed into a red crate2 destroys both crates, and the goal is to remove all pink crates in each level.

ps_skipping_stones-v1.title: Skipping Stones to Lonely Homes
ps_skipping_stones-v1.author: Alan Hazelden
ps_skipping_stones-v1.summary: Push pebbles onto water to make lily-pad paths, redirect currents and dig treasure, then reach the ship while avoiding whirlpools.

ps_sleepy_players-v1.title: Sleepy players
ps_sleepy_players-v1.author: Marcos Donnantuoni
ps_sleepy_players-v1.summary: Several players move in unison, pushing crates; players cannot enter the target cell, and all crates must end on targets.

ps_sliding_ground-v1.title: Sliding ground
ps_sliding_ground-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_sliding_ground-v1.summary: Pushing crates onto targets while the floor tiles under the player slide along with their movement, carrying crates; tiles over pits can vanish.

ps_slidings-v1.title: Slidings
ps_slidings-v1.author: Alain Brobecker
ps_slidings-v1.summary: The player slides until blocked and the action button cyclically permutes objects.

ps_slime_swap-v1.title: Slime Swap
ps_slime_swap-v1.author: Alan Hazelden
ps_slime_swap-v1.summary: Walk into slimes to swap places with them (slimes can swap with crates too), push crates, avoid holes that destroy things, and reach the exit.

ps_smother-v1.title: Smother
ps_smother-v1.author: Team Borse
ps_smother-v1.summary: Lasers fired from emitters kill the victim character; guide victims (with protector moving along, or pushing blocks to block lasers) to the exits while collecting hearts.

ps_snakehole-v1.title: Snakehole
ps_snakehole-v1.author: Jack Kutilek
ps_snakehole-v1.summary: A snake grows a body trail by eating food and pushes snake-like crates onto targets, then retreats into its hole once all food is eaten.

ps_sok7-v1.title: Sok7
ps_sok7-v1.author: Kevin Cancienne
ps_sok7-v1.summary: Push numbered discs; a disc vanishes when the contiguous line it sits in has length equal to its number, while garbage spawns, and you win by clearing all discs.

ps_sokoban_basic-v1.title: Simple Block Pushing Game
ps_sokoban_basic-v1.author: David Skinner
ps_sokoban_basic-v1.summary: A basic Sokoban: the player pushes crates around walls so that every target is covered by a crate.

ps_sokobond-v1.title: Sokobond: The Demake
ps_sokobond-v1.author: Jonah Ostroff
ps_sokobond-v1.summary: Push atoms around; adjacent atoms bond using their free electrons, bonded molecules move together, and the level is won when no unfilled electron orbitals remain.

ps_sokofun_clone-v1.title: Sokofun Clone
ps_sokofun_clone-v1.author: ncrecc
ps_sokofun_clone-v1.summary: Sokoban variant where same-colored blocks must be pushed to touch, fragile blocks fall in holes or are destroyed by lasers, and crates cover targets.

ps_some_lines_crossed-v1.title: Some lines were meant to be crossed
ps_some_lines_crossed-v1.author: Frpzzd
ps_some_lines_crossed-v1.summary: Walk along a path network, turning each path cell into wall (crossing every line, with crossings filling in), then return to the start cell without retracing.

ps_some_pits-v1.title: Some pits
ps_some_pits-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_some_pits-v1.summary: Crate types differ in how they enter, survive, or fill pits.

ps_spacekoban-v1.title: Spacekoban
ps_spacekoban-v1.author: Connorses [Loneship Games]
ps_spacekoban-v1.summary: Zero-gravity Sokoban where pushing sends the player and crates drifting in the opposite or same direction until stopped, with ladders and beams modifying movement.

ps_spikes_n_stuff-v1.title: Spikes 'n' Stuff
ps_spikes_n_stuff-v1.author: Alan Hazelden
ps_spikes_n_stuff-v1.summary: Move through rooms of timed spike traps and line-of-sight arrow traps, pushing crates and gems as shields, to bring the player and gems to the exit cells.

ps_spooky_pumpkin_game-v1.title: Spooky Pumpkin Game
ps_spooky_pumpkin_game-v1.author: Alan Hazelden
ps_spooky_pumpkin_game-v1.summary: Push pumpkins and candles so lit candles light every empty pumpkin, with fire spreading to adjacent unlit candles and webs; win when no unlit pumpkins remain.

ps_stairs-v1.title: Stairs
ps_stairs-v1.summary: Stair tiles of height 1-6 can be climbed only one level at a time, otherwise they get pushed; the player must reach the goal on a high stair.

ps_stairways-v1.title: Stairways
ps_stairways-v1.author: Franklin P. Dyer
ps_stairways-v1.summary: Walk the player onto the stairs; pushing a block moves every block in its whole row or column together, so blocks must be shuffled out of the way.

ps_stalemate_yourself-v1.title: Stalemate yourself
ps_stalemate_yourself-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_stalemate_yourself-v1.summary: Push crates and chess-piece blocks (rook, bishop, queen) whose attack lines are lethal, to trap yourself so you have no legal moves left.

ps_stand_off-v1.title: Stand Off
ps_stand_off-v1.author: Mark Richardson
ps_stand_off-v1.summary: Reach the exit while enemies with line of sight shoot you; draw a gun in a direction to kill them, push crates to block sight, and windows break from bullets.

ps_sticky-v1.title: sticky
ps_sticky-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_sticky-v1.summary: Sokoban variant where walking pushes a chain of crates and the player's shift also moves crates sticking along the same line; cover all targets with crates.

ps_sumoban-v1.title: SumoBan
ps_sumoban-v1.author: Marcos Donnantuoni
ps_sumoban-v1.summary: Push chains of two sumo wrestlers into walls to eliminate them; the last remaining sumotori becomes the winner, so all but one must be removed.

ps_swap-v1.title: swap
ps_swap-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_swap-v1.summary: Walking into a crate swaps the player with the last crate in a row, so the player teleports through the line of crates; cover every target with a crate.

ps_take_heart_lass-v1.title: Take Heart Lass
ps_take_heart_lass-v1.author: Kevin Zuhn
ps_take_heart_lass-v1.summary: Hope and despair spread through space and interact with walls, crates, and the target.

ps_telefrag-v1.title: Telefrag
ps_telefrag-v1.author: CHz
ps_telefrag-v1.summary: Forklift pushes red and green blocks into pits to make bridges, uses terminals to reset one block color, and must reach the goal.

ps_teleporters-v1.title: Teleporters
ps_teleporters-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_teleporters-v1.summary: Push blocks and walk into teleporter pads that swap player and block positions between purple and green portals, and get a sliding block onto every target.

ps_test_gist_script-v1.title: Test Gist Script
ps_test_gist_script-v1.author: diN0bot, copied from Stephen Lavelle
ps_test_gist_script-v1.summary: A basic Sokoban: push the crate through a walled maze onto the target.

ps_the_art_of_cloning-v1.title: the art of cloning
ps_the_art_of_cloning-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_the_art_of_cloning-v1.summary: Push a crate that clones itself into every empty floor cell it leaves behind, until crates cover all the red target crosses.

ps_the_art_of_storage-v1.title: The art of storage
ps_the_art_of_storage-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_the_art_of_storage-v1.summary: Push crates onto every red cross target while a spawner emits a new crate into its cell whenever it is empty; cover all targets.

ps_the_big_dig-v1.title: the big dig
ps_the_big_dig-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_the_big_dig-v1.summary: The player digs through dirt walls, turning them into pushable crates, and pushes crates (which are destroyed by dirt) to cover every target.

ps_the_copying-v1.title: the copying
ps_the_copying-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_the_copying-v1.summary: Push crates into cloners to make copies of crates (or walls), then cover every target with crates or walls.

ps_the_packing_crate-v1.title: The packing crate
ps_the_packing_crate-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_the_packing_crate-v1.summary: Push crates into pits to fill them (the pack leaves behind a spawned crate when you stand on the button) and get the pack onto the target.

ps_the_switch-v1.title: the switch
ps_the_switch-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_the_switch-v1.summary: A propagated switch state converts pushable and pullable crate types.

ps_the_walls_you_leave_behind-v1.title: the walls you leave behind
ps_the_walls_you_leave_behind-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_the_walls_you_leave_behind-v1.summary: Sokoban-style game where the player pushes crates onto targets, and cells the player leaves become walls that crates can destroy or that block movement.

ps_the_workshop-v1.title: The Workshop
ps_the_workshop-v1.author: bregehr
ps_the_workshop-v1.summary: Directional cutters and material-specific objects must be manipulated into matching goals.

ps_then_another-v1.title: Then another
ps_then_another-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_then_another-v1.summary: Crates move in sync with the player's moves, and spawners make a new crate whenever none exists; the player must reach the target cell around walls.

ps_tidy_the_cafe-v1.title: Tidy the Cafe!
ps_tidy_the_cafe-v1.author: Sally Bridgwater
ps_tidy_the_cafe-v1.summary: Push tables and chairs so every chair ends up tucked in against a table on the correct side; candles randomly change flame sprite as decoration.

ps_tile_step-v1.title: Tile Step
ps_tile_step-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_tile_step-v1.summary: Walking onto arrow tiles shifts all crates in that direction (until blocked); the player also pushes orange crates, and all targets must be covered.

ps_tiny_treasure_hunt-v1.title: tiny treasure hunt 1.0
ps_tiny_treasure_hunt-v1.author: Weeble
ps_tiny_treasure_hunt-v1.summary: Player pushes crates and sliding ice around lava pits, climbs stairs to ledges, and collects all coins; lava kills the player and burns crates or melts ice.

ps_to_nothing_and_back-v1.title: To nothing and back
ps_to_nothing_and_back-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_to_nothing_and_back-v1.summary: Push colored crates that merge or combine (red+orange makes new crates, crate5 pairs) to produce a pink crate and push it onto the target.

ps_train-v1.title: Train
ps_train-v1.summary: Push carts onto tracks, where idle carts spawn copies on adjacent track; cover all pads with carts to destroy the gates, then walk to the goal.

ps_triple_match-v1.title: triple match
ps_triple_match-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_triple_match-v1.summary: Push colored crates so three or more of the same color line up and vanish; clear every crate to win.

ps_tunnel_rat-v1.title: Tunnel Rat
ps_tunnel_rat-v1.author: James Noeckel
ps_tunnel_rat-v1.summary: Dig and climb through procedurally scrolling dirt, dodging falling rocks and enemies and using pickups, to get the player onto the exit cells.

ps_unclean_residues-v1.title: Unclean Residues
ps_unclean_residues-v1.author: Stephen Lavelle
ps_unclean_residues-v1.summary: Sokoban where contaminated stones spread directional marks to stones they touch, blocking pushes from certain sides; cover all targets with stones.

ps_using_pushers-v1.title: Using Pushers
ps_using_pushers-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_using_pushers-v1.summary: Directional pusher objects redirect and propagate crate movement.

ps_vines-v1.title: Vines
ps_vines-v1.author: Stefan Peeters
ps_vines-v1.summary: Platformer where light beams shining on vine ends make vines grow; push boxes to block or open light, climb vines and ladders, and reach the target.

ps_wall_bonding-v1.title: Wall-bonding
ps_wall_bonding-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_wall_bonding-v1.summary: Push crates, which are rigidly bonded to adjacent walls and move them too, to maneuver the player onto the target at the top of each level.

ps_wall_movement-v1.title: Wall movement
ps_wall_movement-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_wall_movement-v1.summary: Sokoban-style game where pushed crates must cover all targets, while crates dynamically generate and remove blocking wall segments in cells along their lines.

ps_wall_shuffle-v1.title: wall shuffle
ps_wall_shuffle-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_wall_shuffle-v1.summary: Pushing a crate can also move walls and alter target access.

ps_wall_virus-v1.title: wall virus
ps_wall_virus-v1.author: Rosden Shadow [Mark Signorelli]
ps_wall_virus-v1.summary: Different crate types interact with and transform walls and each other.

ps_world_generation-v1.title: World Generation in PuzzleScript
ps_world_generation-v1.author: 8-bit Llama
ps_world_generation-v1.summary: A sandbox procedural terrain generator: the player walks, pushes wood into water, and chops trees or mines ore into items. There are no win conditions.
